records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in revenue was driven primarily by lower volume in the TPS and OFE segments, partially offset by increased activity in the OFS segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Equipment orders were up $0.4 billion, or 17%, and service orders were up $0.4 billion, or 14%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: DS revenue growth continues to be affected by supply chain constraints that impacted product deliveries.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Oil and natural gas prices increased during the three and six months ended June 30, 2022 largely driven by supply constraints which has also been amplified as a result of recent geopolitical events.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Loss before income taxes was $655 million for the second quarter of 2022, which included restructuring, impairment and other charges of $362 million, inventory impairment charges of $31 million, and also included a loss on our OFS Russia business held for sale of $426 million, and a loss of $123 million from the change in fair value on certain equity securities, both recorded as other non-operating loss.
